stem:
An equation for a chemical reaction is shown.

NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O

Which statement provides evidence that mass is conserved in the reaction?

options.label: A
options.text: Two new substances are formed in the products.

options.label: B
options.text: Water is one of the products, but not one of the reactants.

options.label: C
options.text: Two hydrogen atoms are in the reactants, and two hydrogen atoms are in the products.

options.label: D
options.text: One chlorine atom pairs with one sodium atom in the products, and one chlorine atom pairs with one hydrogen atom in the reactants.
